text: BETON, Shakhtar Donetsk's title sponsor, is the brand of SITIKOD LLC, a licensed Ukrainian online-casino and betting operator; according to public records its founder and beneficial owner is Roman Balashov, who also manages and owns 6.4423% of JSC Chicago, the owner of the Be, Bet, Beton-Casino and Beton Games trademarks.
short: BETON is the brand of SITIKOD LLC; beneficial owner Roman Balashov

source.name: FC Shakhtar: Shakhtar and BETON: new title sponsor of the club
source.note: The club's own announcement identifies the operator behind the BETON brand as SITIKOD LLC.
source.quote: SITIKOD LLC working under the BETON brand is a licensed Ukrainian operator in the field of online casino and betting activities.

additionalSources.name: Komersant Ukrainian: BETON Enters the World of Professional Soccer: Shakhtar's New Sponsor Turns Out to Be Linked to Kamyshin's Business Circle
additionalSources.note: Komersant says the brand operates through CITYCODE LLC while naming SITIKOD LLC's beneficial owner; the two sources disagree on the operating company (noted in the pull request).
additionalSources.quote: According to public records, the founder and beneficial owner of SITIKOD LLC is Roman Balashov, who simultaneously manages and owns 6.4423% of JSC “Chicago”
